item: RavKav / survey bus ratio by window, with and without education trips
result: AM 06:00-09:00: 0.73 (education 40% of survey trips; 1.22 without them); PM 16:00-19:00: 0.96 (education 13% of survey trips; 1.10 without them); midday 10:00-14:00: 0.92 (education 19% of survey trips; 1.13 without them)
explanation: The AM shortfall of RavKav against the survey (0.74) is absent at midday and in the PM peak (0.93-0.96), when home-based education is 13-19 % of the survey bus trips instead of 40 %. Hypothesis: student / school trips are under-recorded in the extract or over-weighted in the survey; to be checked with the data provider.
